UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a user registered on the Haraj Al-Yemen car marketplace, allowing them to create listings, save searches, and manage their profile.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity.

email.description: The user's email address, used for communication and login. This must be unique across all users.

username.description: A unique username chosen by the user for display purposes on the platform.

firstName.description: The first name of the user.

lastName.description: The last name of the user.

phoneNumber.description: The user's phone number, potentially used for direct contact regarding listings if they opt-in.

location.description: The general geographical location of the user (e.g., city, region), used for localizing listings and searches.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was initially created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the user profile was last updated.

CarListing.title: CarListing
CarListing.description: Represents a detailed advertisement for a car available for sale on the Haraj Al-Yemen marketplace.

id.description: Unique identifier for the CarListing entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who created and owns this car listing. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N CarListing)

title.description: A concise and informative title for the car listing, e.g., '2018 Toyota Camry for Sale'.

make.description: The manufacturer or brand of the car (e.g., 'Toyota', 'Nissan').

model.description: The specific model of the car (e.g., 'Camry', 'Patrol', 'Hilux').

year.description: The manufacturing year of the car.

price.description: The asking price for the car.

currency.description: The currency in which the price is listed (e.g., 'YER' for Yemeni Rial, 'USD').

description.description: A detailed narrative description of the car, including features, condition, and history, possibly assisted by AI.

images.description: An array of URLs, each pointing to a high-resolution image of the car.

mileage.description: The total distance the car has traveled, typically measured in kilometers.

transmissionType.description: The type of transmission in the car (e.g., 'automatic', 'manual').

fuelType.description: The type of fuel the car uses (e.g., 'petrol', 'diesel', 'electric', 'hybrid').

bodyType.description: The body style of the car (e.g., 'sedan', 'SUV', 'hatchback', 'pickup truck').

color.description: The exterior color of the car.

location.description: The specific city or region where the car is physically located, facilitating local searches.

status.description: The current status of the listing (e.g., 'active', 'sold', 'pending', 'draft', 'expired').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the car listing was initially created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the car listing was last updated.

viewCount.description: The total number of times this listing has been viewed by prospective buyers.

SavedSearch.title: SavedSearch
SavedSearch.description: Represents a set of search criteria saved by a user for convenient re-application and potential notifications on new matching listings.

id.description: Unique identifier for the SavedSearch entity.

userId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who saved this search. (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N SavedSearch)

searchName.description: A user-defined, descriptive name for this saved search (e.g., 'My SUV Search', 'Toyota Sedans in Sana'a').

criteriaJson.description: A JSON string representing the specific search filters and keywords (e.g., '{"make": "Toyota", "minPrice": 5000, "bodyType": "SUV", "location": "Sana'a"}').

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the saved search was initially created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the saved search was last updated.

Message.title: Message
Message.description: Represents a direct communication or inquiry between a buyer and a seller regarding a specific car listing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Message entity.

senderId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who sent this message (typically the buyer). (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Message)

receiverId.description: Reference to the UserProfile who is the intended recipient of this message (typically the seller). (Relationship: UserProfile 1:N Message)

carListingId.description: Reference to the CarListing that this message is related to. (Relationship: CarListing 1:N Message)

subject.description: A brief subject line summarizing the message content.

body.description: The main content or text of the message being sent.

sentAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the message was sent.

isRead.description: A flag indicating whether the message has been read by the receiver.

params.description: The unique identifier for the saved search.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure for Haraj Al-Yemen is designed to be secure, scalable, and debuggable by strictly adhering to the core design principles and mandates. 

**1. Authorization Independence (CRITICAL):**

*   **User Profiles (`/users/{userId}`):** Authorization is achieved through path-based ownership. The `userId` in the path directly corresponds to `request.auth.uid`, ensuring that no `get()` operations are needed in security rules to determine ownership. Each user's profile document (`UserProfile`) is stored as `/users/{userId}`, where the document ID is the Firebase Authentication UID.
*   **Public Car Listings (`/carListings/{listingId}`):** Each `CarListing` document explicitly includes the `userId` of the owner. This denormalization allows security rules to check `resource.data.userId == request.auth.uid` for write operations without requiring a `get()` call to any other document. This maintains atomicity and simplifies rules.
*   **User Car Listing Drafts (`/users/{userId}/carListingDrafts/{draftId}`):** Similar to User Profiles, authorization is path-based. The `{userId}` in the path ensures that only the authenticated user matching that UID can access their own drafts, eliminating the need for `get()` calls.
*   **Saved Searches (`/users/{userId}/savedSearches/{searchId}`):** Follows the same path-based authorization as drafts, with `{userId}` explicitly defining ownership.
*   **Messages (`/messages/{messageId}`):** Each `Message` document explicitly contains both `senderId` and `receiverId`. Security rules can directly evaluate `request.auth.uid == resource.data.senderId || request.auth.uid == resource.data.receiverId` for read/write access. This denormalization avoids any `get()` operations for authorization.

**2. Structural Segregation (Homogeneous Security Posture):**

*   **Public vs. Private Listings:** Active, publicly visible car listings are stored in `/carListings/{listingId}`. These documents are designed for broad read access and owner-only write access. In contrast, private `draft` listings are segregated into `/users/{userId}/carListingDrafts/{draftId}`, where they are strictly accessible only by the owning user. This separation simplifies rules; `/carListings` rules only need to check `status: 'active'` for public reads, while `/users/{userId}/carListingDrafts` rules only need to check path-based ownership.
*   **User-Specific Data:** All user-specific, private data like `UserProfile`, `CarListingDrafts`, and `SavedSearch` entities are nested under `/users/{userId}/`, reinforcing path-based ownership and distinct security postures from public data.

**3. QAPs (Secure List Operations):**

*   **Public Car Listings:** The `/carListings` collection supports secure `list` operations for any user (authenticated or unauthenticated). Rules can efficiently ensure that only `active` listings are returned, as all documents in this collection share the same security posture (publicly readable if active).
*   **User-Owned Data:** For `/users/{userId}/carListingDrafts` and `/users/{userId}/savedSearches`, `list` operations are implicitly secure. A user can only query their own subcollections by providing their `request.auth.uid` as `{userId}` in the path.
